town_description: Asansol is West Bengal's second city and the administrative centre of Paschim Bardhaman district, in the state's western coal belt. A major railway junction and industrial city of coal mines and steel plants, it is nicknamed the 'City of Brotherhood' and anchors a cluster of Shakti, Shiva and other Hindu shrines in its suburbs and nearby towns.
